market_shrinkage.comment: p_used = w*p_model + (1-w)*q_fair (Design §6.5). Fitted on validation data to maximise realised log-growth, never assumed. w near zero is a valid and publishable finding (Requirements §8.4). Null until Phase 5 fits it.

benchmark.comment: DECIDED: the de-vigged consensus closing price (AvgC*) is the primary market benchmark. That confines the headline comparison to 2019/20 onward, because consensus closing columns do not exist before then — verified against the live archive, not assumed from Requirements §7.3. Pinnacle's own closing price reaches back to 2012/13 and is retained as a SECONDARY, single-book benchmark for calibration and RPS work over a longer horizon; it is never mixed into the primary number. 2025/26 sits after the Pinnacle regime break and is held entirely separate rather than pooled (Requirements §7.3). holdout_season is the NFR-10 untouched season: the last pre-break season, so it shares a regime with the training window.

devig.comment: FR-28. Selected per competition in Notebook 12 by log-loss and calibration error against realised outcomes. Default is Shin rather than proportional because proportional de-vig systematically overstates longshot fair probability and would manufacture phantom value on draws and away underdogs (Design §6.2).

grading.comment: Design §6.4. c_edge is deliberately NON-monotonic: exp(-((edge_prob - e_peak)/sigma)^2), with an automatic F above e_ceiling. An apparent 20-point edge in a market this efficient almost always means the model is blind to something, not that the market is wrong.

guardrails.comment: FR-33. Evaluated BEFORE grading; each firing forces grade F with a logged reason. odds_coverage=false is also a guardrail and is enforced from the taxonomy, not from this file.

staking.comment: Design §6.5. lambda defaults to 0.25; the backtest publishes the full growth-vs-drawdown frontier rather than asserting one value. Caps are fractions of bankroll.

market_engine.comment: Design §6.1 / §11. matrix_max_goals is the truncation point deferred from Design §11; the matrix is renormalised after truncation and Phase 3 asserts it sums to ~1.

reporting.comment: The CLV label is mandatory and literal (Design §6.6): football-data.co.uk's base snapshot is Friday afternoon, not a true opening line, so measured movement understates what an early bettor could capture. min_cell_sample_size greys out edge-map cells rather than displaying noise as signal (Design §6.8).

odds_regime.comment: Requirements §7.3. Pinnacle was dropped from Max/Avg on this date. Pooling the two regimes without adjustment is a correctness bug, so the default forbids it.

comment: FR-16a / Requirements line 250. The rule MODEL_CARD §5 measured (+0.51% CLV,
Pinnacle-referenced) CANNOT be traded: Pinnacle is not published in the live
fixture feed. scripts/study_selection_rules.py asks which references the feed
does carry behave the same way.
Pre-break (2019/20-2023/24, holdout excluded, 7,790 matches) only Pinnacle
works: +0.51% CLV at t=+7.53. B365 shows nothing (-0.07%, t=-1.09) and the
consensus is actively negative (-0.23%, t=-3.35). Betfair Exchange does not
exist before 2024/25, and 2024/25 is the NFR-10 holdout.
Post-break (2025/26 onward, 1,781 matches) Betfair Exchange leads at +2.51%,
t=+7.86, against an unselected baseline of -0.03%. B365 and Pinnacle are also
positive there. That is promising and it is NOT sufficient.

blocked_by.requirement: Requirements line 250 — CLV over >=2 full historical seasons
blocked_by.reason: One season. The same consensus-referenced rule has OPPOSITE signs in the two regimes (-0.23% pre-break, +1.17% post-break), which is what a regime-specific artifact looks like, so a single post-break season cannot distinguish a real effect from a transient one.
blocked_by.unblocks_when: 2026-2027 completes, giving a second post-break season

not_used_and_why.odds_max_as_reference: Selecting on the max-vs-consensus spread and then scoring the max price's movement scores a variable on itself. Measured: the spread narrows from +11.64% to +10.23% on selected rows while the consensus moves 0.28% AGAINST the bet. Regression to the mean, not edge.
not_used_and_why.odds_b365: No pre-break signal (-0.07%, t=-1.09) despite being in the feed.
